sloka: ते द्रुमैः पर्वताग्रैश्च मुष्टिभिश्च प्लवङ्गमाः ।प्राकाराग्राण्यरण्यानि ममन्थुस्तोरणानि च ।। ६.४२.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: te drumaiḥ parvatāgraiśca muṣṭibhiśca plavaṅgamāḥ ।prākārāgrāṇyaraṇyāni mamanthustoraṇāni ca ।। 6.42.15 ।।।।

translations.english: With the means of mountain peaks, as well as their fists, the Vanaras scaled the boundary walls and gateways of the city.
